test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

What were you taught at the creative writing workshop?

options.text: What are they teaching you at the creative writing workshop?
What do they teach you at the creative writing workshop?
What have they taught you at the creative writing workshop?
What did they teach you at the creative writing workshop?

solution: The correct answer is **'What did they teach you at the creative writing workshop?'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is in Passive Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Active Voice. • The structure of the given sentence is as follows: • **Wh word + V2 + Subject + Object? (Active Voice)** • **Wh word + was/were + subject + V3 + Object? (Passive Voice)** • In the given sentence **'were taught'** will be changed into '**did teach**' because the given sentence is in the **passive voice.** • '**you**' will be changed into '**they**'. (***Passive to Active transformation***) **Correct Sentence:__** *What did they teach you at the creative writing workshop?* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** __ • दिया गया वाक्य Passive Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Active Voice में बदलना है। • दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है: • **Wh word + V2 + Subject + Object? (Active Voice)** • **Wh word + was/were + subject + V3 + Object? (Passive Voice)** • यहाँ दिए गए वाक्य **'were taught' **को **'did teach' **में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि दिया गया वाक्य **passive voice **में है। • '**you**' को '**they**' में बदल दिया जाएगा। (**Passive to Active transformation**) 38:T56d, The correct answer is **Becoming less acceptable**__.
